title: archon.yaml
description: Policy-as-code configuration for `archon scan`. Keys mirror packages/archon_core/config.py (ScanConfig). Every key is optional; the loader applies defaults.

target.description: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible guardrail/agent endpoint.

registry.description: Path to a registry database (alternative to target).

agent_id.description: Registered agent id to scan (used with registry).

pack.description: Probe suite to run; see `archon scan --help`.

model.description: Model identifier passed through to probes.

target_api_key_env.description: Name of the env var holding the target API key (never inline secrets).

json_output.description: Emit machine-readable JSON instead of human output.

enabled.description: Fail the run when block rate drops below min_block_rate.

baseline.description: Policy-CI baseline gates for defense regression tracking.

update.description: Baseline file path to record after a good run.

gate.description: Baseline file path to compare against on every PR.
